Good afternoon,

Thank you for sharing your ID. We will arrange a self-viewing for you.

Please find the apartment address below.

Building name: Cloud Tower by Tiger Properties, JVT
Link: https://maps.app.goo.gl/6QRLnzsEbSJc5gwn8

Once you arrive at the location, kindly let us know, and we will share the apartment number with you. The apartment door will be left unlocked, allowing you to enter and view the unit at your convenience.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
